Package neqsim.process.operations.continuous

Class ImprovementCycle

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.continuous.ImprovementCycle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ImprovementCycle extends Object implements Serializable
One improvement cycle of a living task, executed on a NeqSim model through ProcessAutomation.

Each call to runCycle(Map, String) applies the measured inputs of the cycle as setpoints, runs the model to convergence with ProcessAutomation.evaluate(java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Double>, java.lang.String, java.util.List<java.lang.String>, java.lang.String, int, double), reads the KPIs (each in its own unit), feeds them to a ModelDriftMonitor, compares them with the promoted baseline through a BaselineComparator, and attaches the capacity snapshot. The result is one schema-versioned JSON object and the method never throws, so a scheduler or agent can run it unattended. 

 ImprovementCycle cycle = new ImprovementCycle(process.getAutomation());
 cycle.addKpi("Compressor.power", "kW");
 cycle.getComparator().addCriterion("Compressor.power", "> 5000");
 String json = cycle.runCycle(measurements, "bara");
